name: basics
description: Short questions with one right answer: math, letter counting, facts, trick questions, following a rule, and passing a cipher message.

cases.prompt: What is 17 times 23?
What is 144 divided by 12?
What is 15% of 80?
I have 3 apples and buy 2 dozen more. How many apples do I have now?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How many cents does the ball cost?
What is 2 to the power of 10?
How many times does the letter r appear in the word strawberry?
How many letters are in the word banana?
How many times does the letter e appear in the word excellence?
What is the capital of Australia?
What is the capital of Canada?
Which planet is closest to the Sun?
Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
What is the chemical symbol for gold?
How many months of the year have 28 days?
Which is heavier, a kilogram of feathers or a kilogram of steel?
In a race, you pass the person in second place. What place are you in now?
Name a fruit.
List three colors.
cases.rule: Write your whole reply in lowercase letters.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
cases.rule: Never use the letter e in your reply.

cases.prompt: meet at noon
the eagle has landed
